chapter: Black and Tan and Kansas City nightlife
title: The Sunset Nightclub on Eighteenth and Vine
summary: The Italian owner converted a theater into the Sunset, hiring Basie, Julia Lee and Twelve Clouds of Joy.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And, uh, later on, then we went to Eighteenth Street. Same I-talian had the club on Independence Avenue when we went to Eighteenth Street--Eighteenth and Vine--called the Sunset Nightclub. Was...used to be a theater, and we got 'em to take all the benches out an' everything an' rented the joint and made a nightclub out of it. Had Count Basie playin' there. We had George Lee, Julia Lee and they band, the musicians' brothers' (?) band, Twelve Clouds of Joy. We had a...let me see...in fact, we had a whole gang of people. All the big bands come out of New York, they come right there.
And they worked at the Sunset.
Yeah, we hire 'em. We'd hire any band that come in there.
How long would...would they work there? Two or three weeks, or how long?
